title: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) in Patients Hospitalized for Acute Decompensated Heart Failure.
brief_summary: The presence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) would confer increased in-hospital mortality and length of hospital stay in patients with acute decompensated heart failure Assess the (1) prevalence of COPD in patients who are hospitalized for acute decompensated heart failure and (2) the association between COPD and in-hospital mortality or length of stay in this cohort.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Heart failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Ambulatory patients
study_population: Patients hospitalized for acute decompensated heart Failure
